016public class CryopodOfficerGen {
017
018        public static String EXCEPTIONAL_OFFICERS_CREATED_KEY = "$SleeperPodsSpecialCreator_exceptionalCount";
019        
020        public static int getNumExceptionalCreated() {
021                return Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getInt(EXCEPTIONAL_OFFICERS_CREATED_KEY);
022        }
023        
024        public static void incrNumExceptionalCreated() {
025                int num = getNumExceptionalCreated() + 1;
026                Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().set(EXCEPTIONAL_OFFICERS_CREATED_KEY, num);
027        }
028        
029        public static boolean canAddMoreExceptional() {
030                return getNumExceptionalCreated() < SalvageSpecialAssigner.MAX_EXCEPTIONAL_PODS_OFFICERS;
031        }
032

035        public static class CryopodOfficerTemplate {
036                public List<String> base = new ArrayList<String>();
037                public List<String> elite = new ArrayList<String>();
038                
039                public String personality = null;
040                
041                
042                public CryopodOfficerTemplate() {
043                }
044                public CryopodOfficerTemplate(String personality) {
045                        this.personality = personality;
046                }
047
048                public PersonAPI create(FactionAPI faction, Random random) {
049                        PersonAPI officer = faction.createRandomPerson(random);
050                        if (personality != null) {
051                                officer.setPersonality(personality);
052                        }
053                        
054                        officer.setRankId(Ranks.SPACE_CAPTAIN);
055                        officer.setPostId(Ranks.POST_OFFICER);
056                        
057                        int level = base.size() + elite.size();
058                        officer.getStats().setLevel(level);
059                        
060                        OfficerLevelupPlugin plugin = (OfficerLevelupPlugin) Global.getSettings().getPlugin("officerLevelUp");
061                        officer.getStats().setXP(plugin.getXPForLevel(level));
062                        
063                        for (String id : base) {
064                                officer.getStats().setSkillLevel(id, 1);
065                        }
066                        for (String id : elite) {
067                                officer.getStats().setSkillLevel(id, 2);
068                        }
069                        return officer;
070                }
071        }
